words: Publisher 0.4.0 carries the history-scope pair into each series: history_scope_claim = inferred and history_scope_basis = the fixed text 'first value day vs source floor', taken from the NEWEST gold row's conditional column history_scope_claim only. A null or absent claim, or a claim on older rows only, writes no pair, and any other claim word is refused. validate_against_contract refuses a lone field, another word or a free-text basis. Both publish handlers read the conditional column only from a partition whose own Parquet schema names it, so a legacy partition written before the derivation neither fails nor makes any statement, and a series built from legacy gold carries no pair. The four pinned tests carry the 0.4.0 pins (amendment 1 added test_handler_unreported.py): 12 worker-made lines. Not proven: nothing is built, uploaded or republished; the two source-map entries for the publisher and the handlers are stale after this cell and are re-pinned by a later cell; no producer has written the claim to S3 yet; and the checker's pinned-line recount reads 223 because it counts the carried DB-b-292 file copy (BLOCKING row IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W238-S2), so DB163-1-AC3 is not met.
